description: Cursor Agent CLI as a long-running resident engine node — the same three wakes as engine-cursor-resident, invoked with --permissions bypass. `--permissions bypass` keeps `--force` on `agent acp`. Measured on agent 2026.10.22-27dcf5f: a shell call is not asked. The restricted definition does not pass `--force`, so a tool call is asked and rejected once. Stdin EOF does not end `agent acp`. The bridge cancels an in-flight turn, closes stdin, then SIGTERM and SIGKILL the engine's process group. The session stays up while it works and for `TIMEOUT` seconds of quiet after the last turn (default 2700, 45 minutes), pushing new messages into the active conversation and wrapping up STATUS.md/LESSONS.md at expiry; the next message after that starts a fresh session from STATUS.md. `a8s stop`, `restart` and `kill` end the session at once through `stop.invoke`; `status.invoke` lets `a8s ps` show busy or resident. Enable private K7E memory with `a8s vars <name> set MEMORY on`. Pick a model with `a8s vars <name> set MODEL <id>` (or `a8s add ... --model=<id>`); unset means composer-2.5, not the CLI's own `auto`, which reuses the last model run on the machine and spends on the newest one. An unrestricted node acts on untrusted inbound mail — anyone who can reach its inbox, including over a broker or a shared folder, is driving a CLI that will not ask. Only for an agent on its own machine and its own account. Set the quiet window per node with `a8s vars <name> set TIMEOUT <secs>`. Set MODEL with bracket options such as [effort=high] to select reasoning effort. A separate EFFORT variable is ignored, with one warning. Commit as the agent with `a8s vars <name> set GIT_NAME ...` and `GIT_EMAIL ...`; unset uses git's own config.
